description: Wireless trainer that served with No. 4 Wireless School Flying Squadron and ground-looped at St Catharines on 29 May 1944. Flown by James Cagney in the 1942 film Captains of the Clouds. Aerial Visuals also links this airframe to the Tiger Boys collection at Guelph; unresolved.
Held by the museum at the former No. 6 Service Flying Training School site, Dunnville.
